annotations.title: Get my kind of business for the score

description: Read the kind of business the website score is weighed for: choice (the owner's pick, or null), listing_default (what the OnHand listing gives), options (id, label, group) and can_edit. Use an option id with set_visibility_site_type. Requires company:read; the account selects the business. Read-only.
name: get_visibility_site_type
